description: Totals line items, applies a discount and HST, and computes a deposit. No customer details taken. Returns { lines, grossCents, discountCents, subtotalCents, hstCents, totalCents, rate, depositCents }. Price: 5 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

depositPct.description: Deposit as a percent of the tax-included total.

discountPct.description: Discount on the gross total, in percent.

qty.description: Quantity, a whole number of at least 1.

sku.description: Product code or short label; the first 40 characters are kept (default item-N).

unitCents.description: Unit price in integer CAD cents, pre-tax.
